title: Strengthening Lembang Fault Preparedness, Communities Take Part in Sekolah Lapang Gempa Bumi (Earthquake Field School)
excerpt: BMKG Bandung held the Sekolah Lapang Gempa Bumi (Earthquake Field School) in Lembang to strengthen community mitigation and preparedness for a potential Lembang Fault earthquake.
seoTitle: Earthquake Field School for Lembang Fault Readiness - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: BMKG Bandung held an Earthquake Field School in Lembang to strengthen community mitigation and preparedness for a potential Lembang Fault earthquake.
html:
The potential for earthquakes caused by activity along the Lembang Fault is a reminder of the importance of community preparedness in facing disasters. Efforts to recognize threats and understand mitigation measures need to be strengthened so that communities can respond to emergencies better prepared.

As part of these efforts, BMKG (Indonesia’s Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency) Bandung held the Sekolah Lapang Gempa Bumi (Earthquake Field School) and Contingency Test at Imah Roti, Lembang, on 26–27 October 2026. The activity involved community representatives, volunteers, and the Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD, the Regional Disaster Management Agency) to strengthen understanding and preparedness capacity in the face of earthquake risk.

On the first day, participants received a theoretical briefing on various types of natural disasters. The activity continued on the second day with a walk along the Lembang Fault and a disaster simulation as a means of recognizing potential threats and understanding the steps to take in an emergency.

Relawan Nusantara took part in this activity as a participant while also providing support for the running of the program. This involvement is part of the effort to encourage preparedness and build community resilience in the face of disaster risk.

Inauguration of Masyarakat Siaga Gempa Sesar Lembang

As part of the series of activities, the Head of BMKG Bandung, Dr. Suaidi Ahadi, S.T., M.T., inaugurated Masyarakat Siaga Gempa Sesar Lembang (the Lembang Fault Earthquake-Ready Community). The inauguration involved Himpunan Ahli Geofisika Indonesia (the Indonesian Association of Geophysicists), BMKG, the provincial BPBD, regency/city BPBDs, BRIN (the National Research and Innovation Agency), and Relawan Nusantara.

This step is part of the effort to sustain the Desa Siaga Bencana (Disaster-Ready Village) program, while strengthening the role of various parties in building community-based preparedness.

Preparedness depends not only on knowledge of potential disasters, but also on the community’s ability to recognize risks, understand safety procedures, and coordinate when an emergency occurs. For that reason, education and simulation are an important part of preparing communities for the possibility of an earthquake.

Collaboration to Build Disaster-Resilient Communities

The Sekolah Lapang Gempa Bumi and Contingency Test are part of a program of BNPB (the National Disaster Management Agency) and Komisi V DPR RI (Commission V of the Indonesian House of Representatives), supported through collaboration with the provincial BPBD, regency/city BPBDs, Relawan Nusantara, BSI, BRIN, and Imah Roti as the venue for the activity.

Through cross-agency collaboration and community involvement, this activity is expected to improve understanding of the earthquake threat, strengthen mitigation capacity, and encourage sustained preparedness in disaster-prone areas.

After all, building resilience to disasters is not only about responding when a disaster strikes, but also about preparing early through knowledge, practice, and cooperation among various parties.

Preparedness efforts and rapid response in the field naturally require ongoing support so that more people in disaster-prone areas are educated and protected.
